summary.text: Caroleene Dobson is the Republican nominee, a Montgomery attorney who was the 2024 Republican nominee in Alabama's 2nd Congressional District, losing to Rep. Shomari Figures with 45% of the vote. Her campaign centers on election-law enforcement and lower business fees.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised on her family's farm in Monroe County; holds an undergraduate degree from Harvard College and a law degree from Baylor University School of Law.
Shareholder at Maynard Nexsen in Montgomery, focusing on natural resources, commercial finance and real estate law.
